title: Roveia closing CTA and footer (v2)
description: A centred 80px closing line, a grey lead and a blue pill, over soft blurred sky-blue hills that fade back to white at the foot; under it a plain wordmark, small social icons and the copyright on the left, three link columns with grey labels on the right. The call to action fades and settles in as it enters; links turn blue on hover.
notes: the blurred hills are soft glow shapes standing in for the original's background art
